invariants.rationale: The method simply returns the value of unitPrice, so result is always exactly unitPrice.
Referencing unitPrice via 'this', result will always be this.unitPrice.
Calling getUnitPrice() at this point returns result, which is unitPrice.
unitPrice is a double field, which is typically finite unless explicitly set otherwise.
It is plausible for unitPrice (and thus result) to be non-negative, as prices per item should not be negative in common order models.
